main.description: Describe a space. Served by the space host. Requires either OAuth (for a caller with an account on this host) or a space credential (for a member hosted elsewhere); either way the caller must be authorized for the space. Returns the space URI plus an open-union `config` carrying host-implementation-specific configuration (e.g. com.atproto.simplespace.defs#spaceConfig). Clients that don't recognize the config variant should ignore it.
